## Problem or motivation

What problem does this solve, or what use case does it enable? Why does it matter for DRIFT's threat model or usability?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to see added or changed. Be as specific as you can.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you prefer your proposal over them.

## Phase fit

Which roadmap phase does this belong to, or is it a new one?

- [ ] Phase 3 — Tor transport + sealed sender
- [ ] Phase 4 — Federated relays + cover traffic
- [ ] Phase 5 — Panic key, decoy volumes, FMD
- [ ] New phase / cross-cutting concern

## Security and privacy considerations

Does this change the threat model, expose new metadata, or touch cryptographic primitives? If so, describe the impact.

## Additional context

Mockups, prior art, related issues, or anything else useful.
